name: Chopped BLT Sliders
desc: Oven bacon, romaine and tomato chopped together with mayo and stuffed into Hawaiian sweet rolls.

source.title: Chopped BLT Sliders
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 (12-count) package King's Hawaiian Original Sweet Rolls
1/4 cup mayonnaise, plus more to taste
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Lay out the bacon and bake about 25 min, until cooked to your liking. Drain off the grease and set the bacon on paper towels.
Carefully tear the rolls into rows of three. Slice into the tops of the rolls without cutting all the way through.
Lay the lettuce on a large cutting board and give it a quick chop. Chop the tomato slices the same way.
Add the bacon and chop everything together into small pieces with a large knife.
Drizzle with the mayonnaise, season with salt and pepper and stir well. Add more mayo if it seems dry.
Scoop the mixture into the rolls and serve right away.
tips: Chop and mix right before serving so the lettuce stays crisp.
